title: HR Administrator
description:
HR Administrator Birmingham City Centre - Hybrid 6 months FTC 29,000

Gleeson Recruitment Group are delighted to be partnering with a global logistics organisation based in Birmingham City Centre who are looking to appoint an experienced HR Administrator to join their People team on an initial temporary basis. This is a fantastic opportunity to join a well-established international business during a busy period, supporting a fast-paced HR function where no two days are the same. You'll be joining a collaborative and supportive team, providing essential HR administration across the full employee lifecycle.

The Role

Reporting into the HR team, you'll play a key role in ensuring the smooth day-to-day running of the HR function, delivering a high-quality administrative service to both employees and stakeholders across the business.

Your responsibilities will include:
- Supporting the full employee lifecycle including starters, leavers and contractual changes.
- Preparing contracts of employment, offer letters and HR documentation.
- Maintaining accurate employee records and updating the HR system.
- Managing the HR inbox and responding to employee queries.
- Coordinating onboarding and pre-employment checks.
- Assisting with recruitment administration and interview scheduling.
- Supporting absence management administration and HR reporting.
- Producing regular HR reports and maintaining personnel files.
- Providing administrative support to the wider HR team and HR Business Partners.
- Ensuring all processes are completed accurately and in line with company policies and employment legislation.

About You

We're keen to speak with candidates who have:
- Previous experience in an HR Administration role.
- Excellent organisational skills and a high level of attention to detail.
- The ability to manage multiple priorities within a busy environment.
- Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
- Experience using HR systems and Microsoft Office, including Excel.
- A proactive approach with the confidence to work independently when required.
- Immediate availability or a short notice period.

What's on Offer
- Opportunity to join a recognised global organisation.
- Birmingham City Centre location with excellent transport links.
- Friendly, supportive HR team.
- Immediate start available.
- Weekly PAYE pay through Gleeson Recruitment Group.
- Potential for the assignment to be extended depending on business requirements.

title: Hr Administrator
description:
We are looking for a HR Administrator to be a trusted first point of contact for People-related queries, helping colleagues get the answers they need, on time, with care and professionalism. This is a hybrid role for someone who enjoys organisation, values confidentiality, and takes pride in delivering accurate administrative support that keeps everything moving smoothly.

If you re the person people rely on to find information quickly, update records correctly and process requests with methodical attention to detail, you ll feel right at home here.

What You ll Do

You ll sit at the heart of our People Services function, providing day-to-day administrative support across the colleague lifecycle. In practical terms, you will:
- Act as the first point of contact for People-related queries, responding with a customer-focused, can-do approach.
- Provide timely, accurate administrative support to help colleagues and managers move from one stage of the lifecycle to the next without delays.
- Maintain data accuracy across People records, ensuring details are correct, consistent and up to date.
- Support and complete colleague lifecycle transactions accurately, including processing requests end-to-end.
- Keep records and documentation organised, ensuring information is easy to find and auditable.
- Use your Excel skills to work with data efficiently, maintain tidy spreadsheets and support accurate reporting where needed.
- Follow processes and service standards carefully, prioritising work to ensure responses and processing are timely and efficient.
- Identify issues early, flag discrepancies appropriately and help improve the quality of the information we hold.

What We Need From You

To be successful in this role, you will have:
- Strong organisation skills, with the ability to manage multiple requests and deadlines.
- A customer-focused mindset, able to communicate clearly with colleagues who may have questions, concerns or time-sensitive needs.
- An accurate, methodical and responsible approach to administration and data quality.
- Experience using Excel, comfortable working with data and maintaining accurate records.
- A commitment to delivering work with integrity especially when handling personal and employment information.
- The confidence to follow processes carefully and escalate where appropriate.

What We Offer
- Annual leave plus bank holidays
- Defined contribution pension
- Employee Assistance Programme

Ready to Make a Difference?

If you re someone who enjoys being the reliable point of contact, takes pride in accurate administration, and can use Excel to keep data clean and dependable, we d love to hear from you. Apply now and help us support our colleagues because everything we do is about people.

title: Internal Recruiter / Supported Living / Care Recruitment Experience
description:
We are looking for an experienced and proactive Internal Recruiter to join our growing supported living organisation in Birmingham.

This is a key role within the organisation, responsible for attracting, screening and recruiting high-quality Support Workers across our supported living services.

Previous experience specifically recruiting Support Workers is essential for this position. We are looking for someone who understands the challenges of recruiting within the care and support sector and knows how to identify candidates who have the right skills, values and attitude to work with the people we support.

You will work closely with Registered Managers, Service Managers and the wider operational team to ensure vacancies are filled efficiently while maintaining high standards of safer recruitment and candidate quality.

Key responsibilities
- Manage the end-to-end recruitment process for Support Workers and other operational care roles.
- Work closely with Service and Registered Managers to understand staffing requirements and recruitment priorities.
- Create and post engaging job adverts designed to attract experienced and suitable Support Worker candidates.
- Proactively source candidates through job boards, social media, recruitment platforms and other channels.
- Review applications and shortlist candidates against role requirements.
- Conduct telephone and video screening interviews with prospective Support Workers.
- Assess candidates' experience, suitability, values and motivation for working in supported living.
- Coordinate interviews with hiring managers and provide feedback throughout the recruitment process.
- Maintain regular communication with candidates to provide a positive recruitment experience.
- Coordinate and monitor pre-employment checks, including right-to-work checks, references and other relevant compliance requirements.
- Ensure recruitment activity follows safer recruitment practices and internal policies.
- Maintain accurate recruitment records and candidate information.
- Manage multiple vacancies across different supported living services and locations.
- Build and maintain strong relationships with hiring managers.
- Develop proactive recruitment campaigns for hard-to-fill Support Worker vacancies.
- Monitor recruitment activity and identify opportunities to improve candidate attraction, conversion and retention.

Essential experience and skills

You must have previous experience recruiting Support Workers.

We are specifically looking for candidates who can demonstrate:
- Previous experience recruiting Support Workers within supported living, social care, healthcare or a closely related setting.
- A strong understanding of what makes a suitable Support Worker candidate.
- Experience managing high-volume or multiple Support Worker vacancies.
- Experience conducting telephone or video screening interviews.
- Experience using job boards and proactive candidate-sourcing methods.
- A good understanding of safer recruitment and pre-employment checks.
- Excellent communication and relationship-building skills.
- Strong organisational skills and the ability to manage competing priorities.
- Excellent attention to detail.
- Confidence working with managers and challenging recruitment requirements where necessary.
- A proactive approach to recruitment rather than relying solely on applications.

Who we're looking for

This role would suit an experienced Care Recruiter, Support Worker Recruiter, Internal Recruiter or Recruitment Consultant who has previously recruited Support Workers and understands the realities of recruiting within the supported living sector.

You should be confident identifying suitable candidates, asking the right questions during screening and recognising the difference between simply filling a vacancy and recruiting someone who is genuinely suited to supporting vulnerable adults.

title: Senior School HR Administrator
description:
Smile Education are currently recruiting for an experienced Senior HR Administrator to join a welcoming and supportive primary school in the B8 area of Birmingham. This is an excellent opportunity for a highly organised and proactive HR professional with previous school-based experience to support the smooth running of the school's HR and administrative functions.
The successful applicant will play a key role in providing comprehensive HR administrative support, maintaining accurate staff records, supporting recruitment and safer recruitment procedures, managing staff absence records, and assisting with a range of HR processes in line with school policies and safeguarding requirements.
Applicants must possess excellent written and verbal communication skills, strong organisational abilities, and previous experience working in an HR or school administration role. Experience using school management information systems, HR databases, and recruitment systems would be highly advantageous.
This is a fantastic opportunity to join a dedicated school team and contribute to the effective management and support of its workforce.
Duties and Responsibilities
- Providing senior-level HR administrative support to the Headteacher, senior leadership team, and school office.
- Maintaining accurate and up-to-date staff records, personnel files, and HR databases.
- Supporting recruitment processes, including advertising vacancies, arranging interviews, preparing documentation, and coordinating pre-employment checks.
- Ensuring safer recruitment and safeguarding procedures are followed, including DBS, right-to-work, reference, and qualification checks.
- Monitoring and maintaining staff absence records, sickness reporting, and return-to-work documentation.
- Assisting with the administration of new starters, leavers, contract changes, and staff induction.
- Preparing HR reports, staff information, and workforce data for senior leaders and governors as required.
- Supporting staff training, professional development, and mandatory compliance requirements.
- Responding professionally to HR-related enquiries from staff, applicants, and external agencies.
- Maintaining confidentiality when handling sensitive employee information and ensuring compliance with data protection requirements.
- Supporting the implementation and review of HR policies and procedures.
- Working collaboratively with school leaders and colleagues to ensure the efficient running of the school's HR function.

The Ideal Candidate Will
- Have previous experience in an HR administration or senior school administration role, ideally within a primary school or educational setting.
- Possess a strong understanding of HR processes, recruitment administration, and employee record management.
- Have experience supporting safer recruitment and safeguarding compliance procedures.
- Demonstrate excellent IT, data management, and administrative skills.
- Have outstanding written and verbal communication skills.
- Be highly organised, proactive, and able to manage competing priorities effectively.
- Demonstrate discretion and professionalism when handling confidential information.
- Have a good understanding of HR policies, employment procedures, and data protection requirements.
- Be able to work independently while contributing positively to a supportive school team.

What to Expect from ApplicantsWe are looking for candidates with previous HR or school administration experience who can confidently support the day-to-day HR operations of a busy primary school.
Experience in recruitment administration, staff absence monitoring, personnel records, safer recruitment checks, and HR systems will be particularly beneficial. Candidates should be confident working with confidential information and supporting senior leaders with accurate workforce data and administrative reporting.
Availability to start immediately would be advantageous.
Why Work with Smile Education?Smile Education are an agency with a difference. We are education specialists with a proven track record of supporting experienced education professionals and those developing their careers. We provide access to training and CPD opportunities and proudly work alongside a number of well-established schools and academy trusts across the local area.
We are passionate about finding the right role for every candidate and supporting schools in building strong, effective teams.
To be successful in your application, you should have experience in one or more of the following:
- HR administration or senior administrative support.
- School-based HR or personnel administration.
- Recruitment coordination and safer recruitment compliance.
- Staff absence management and employee record maintenance.
- Using HR databases, school management systems, or recruitment platforms.
- Supporting senior leaders with HR reporting and workforce administration.

We are committed to safeguarding children. All applicants will be expected to undertake relevant compliance checks, which may include enhanced DBS checks, children's barred list checks where applicable, employment references, right-to-work verification, and qualification checks.
